main.description: The lending of a Copy to someone, from the day it leaves until it comes back. A Loan with no return date is open: the Copy is lent. Returned Loans stay as the Copy's history. Never Shared.

copy.description: Record key of the app.atomes.copy that is lent.

borrower.description: Who has the Copy, as the reader typed it.

returnedAt.description: When the Copy came back. Absent while the Loan is open.
